hero.subtitle: Round-trip transport | Approximately 40-minute flight | Guided tour and tasting

description.title: This is the quintessential ballooning experience.
description.paragraph: The most complete way to discover Teotihuacán: round-trip transport, balloon flight, breakfast, a guided archaeological-zone visit, a craft workshop, and a tequila, mezcal, and pulque tasting. A traveller kit is also included for the day.

steps.title: 5:00 AM - Arrival & Check-in
steps.description: You’ll arrive at Flying Pictures Reception, where our team will welcome you and help you complete check-in.

steps.title: Welcome & Coffee Break
steps.description: After you complete your check-in we will welcome you with our coffee station with hot beverages and traditional cookies.

steps.title: The Inflation Spectacle
steps.description: Walk to the launch field to watch the "Giants" come to life. Seeing the massive balloons rise with the roar of the burners is the first act of the show.

steps.title: The Ascent
steps.description: Lift off gently into the dawn. For approx. 45-60 minutes, float silently over the Valley of Teotihuacán, watching the sun reveal the pyramids from above.

steps.title: The 1783 Toast
steps.description: Upon landing, we celebrate with a traditional sparkling wine toast. A ritual dating back to the first aviators to thank the wind gods for a safe return.

steps.title: Meet us in Mexico City
steps.description: Travel to Teotihuacán in shared transport coordinated by our team.

steps.title: Receive your traveller kit
steps.description: Get a hat, water, and a souvenir for the day's experience.

steps.title: Enjoy the coffee break
steps.description: Coffee, cookies, and traditional Mexican drinks await you.

steps.title: Watch the balloons inflate
steps.description: See the preparation process up close before boarding.

steps.title: Begin the ascent
steps.description: The pilot selects the take-off time according to the day's conditions.

steps.title: Fly for approximately 40 minutes
steps.description: Enjoy views of the Teotihuacán Valley from a Cameron basket.

steps.title: Toast and have breakfast
steps.description: Celebrate the flight, have breakfast, and receive your personalised certificate.

steps.title: Visit a craft workshop
steps.description: Learn about traditional materials and techniques from the region.

steps.title: Taste traditional drinks
steps.description: Sample tequila, mezcal, and pulque as part of the cultural experience.

steps.title: Explore the pyramids with a guide
steps.description: A certified guide accompanies your visit through the archaeological zone.
